catalogMeta.label: Build a Blend Word (open build)
catalogMeta.description: Open build: join a start tile and an ending tile into any real word that STARTS with a blend (bl + ock, st + op) or ENDS with one (l + amp, s + and), then press done; some items ask for a second word. Many words pass. Code checks the blend and the tile order; the shared word judge checks it is a real word. Beta = cvce_blend + 0.1.
